## {{< iconify octicon:beaker-24 aria-hidden='true' >}} Research & Publications {#research}

::: {.highlight}

__*50 peer-reviewed papers*__ in top-tier journals, including __*Nature*__, __*Nature Genetics*__, and __*Diabetes*__.

:::

[M]{.drop-cap}y research covers genome-wide and epigenome-wide association studies, expression quantitative trait loci mapping, and the joint modelling of longitudinal and time-to-event data.
I apply this work mostly to type 2 diabetes and its complications.
Eight of those papers place me as first, co-first, last, or co-last author.
